source_analysis.skill: Expand a cosine of a sum or difference in degrees into a linear combination of sine and cosine of the variable, using exact special-angle values.
reasoning_steps: Identify u and the constant special angle v and select cosine sum or difference identity.
Evaluate cosine and sine of v including quadrant signs.
Multiply coefficients, remove zero terms, combine and reorder into the requested expression or extract each blank coefficient at its displayed sign scope.
invariants: Cosine outer function, degree-valued constant angle, exact values.
Output in sine/cosine of same variable; no double-angle, radians conversion, or new identities required.
Prompt, choice banks, field-local signs, and solution derive from the same instance.
permitted_variations: Sum versus difference; constant special angle and quadrant; variable naming; operand ordering v-x versus x-v justified by direct identity application.
Which term survives at quadrantal boundaries, coefficient signs and sine/cosine order, complete distractor error profiles, keyed option position.
A signed coefficient may lie inside a blank or have an explicit sign outside it, provided the key follows the displayed fragment.
